chunks.subject: AP Precalculus
chunks.title: Q1 — Function Modeling (6 points, calculator)
chunks.content: AP Precalculus FRQ 1 (Part A, graphing calculator required), 6 points, scored by lettered subparts (A/B/C, often with i/ii), each worth points. Q1 topic: exponential/logarithmic function modeling (e.g., fitting or using an exponential regression, evaluating, interpreting a rate/percent change, solving). Points reward: correct model/values from the calculator, correct evaluation/solution with appropriate setup, and correct interpretation in context with units. Common failure: reporting an answer without the required setup; rounding errors; interpretation that omits context/units.

chunks.title: Q1 exemplar — Sample 1A, 6/6
chunks.content: Q1 scored 6/6 — correct model/values, correct evaluations and solutions with setup, and correct contextual interpretations. Full-credit model for the modeling FRQ.

chunks.subject: AP Precalculus
chunks.title: Q1 exemplar — Sample 1B, 5/6
chunks.content: Q1 scored 5/6 — earned nearly all subparts, losing one point, typically an interpretation lacking context/units or a minor calculation/rounding slip. Illustrates a strong response one point short.

chunks.subject: AP Precalculus
chunks.title: Q1 exemplar — Sample 1C, 3/6
chunks.content: Q1 scored 3/6 — earned about half the subparts (e.g., the model and one evaluation), losing solution setups and/or contextual interpretations. Illustrates a response that computes some values but does not complete the modeling/interpretation tasks.
